name: gallivant
description: Write a PRD, mark it ready, go outside. Keeps coding-agent pull requests moving through review and CI without you.

scripts.test:execution-backends: node --test test/execution-backends.test.mjs test/execution-preparation.test.mjs test/probe.test.mjs test/chains.test.mjs test/loop.test.mjs test/recovery.test.mjs test/review.test.mjs test/control.test.mjs test/tracker_controls.test.mjs test/tracker.test.mjs test/public_format.test.mjs test/public_output.test.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check bin/gallivant.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs lib/*/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
